newsitem.title: USA: CME Sept S&P 500s rise seven-point opening limit.
newsitem.headline: CME Sept S&P 500s rise seven-point opening limit.

text.p: CME September Standard & Poor's 500 futures rose the seven-point opening limit, as U.S. T-bond prices remained strong.
September S&Ps rallied seven points to 922.50.
Pit trade would halt for two minutes if September S&Ps were locked at the limit at 0840 CDT/1340 GMT. The market would re-open with no further upside limits.
On GLOBEX, September S&Ps climbed 7.80 points to an all-time high of 923.30. ((Chicago Derivatives desk 312-408-8750))
